protocol_metadata.title: Phase 33 — Cross-Signer Generalization Evaluation Protocol & Next-Phase Acceptance Gates

fold_1_zero_shot_cross_signer.name: Signer-01 -> Signer-04 Zero-Shot Cross-Signer Generalization
fold_1_zero_shot_cross_signer.purpose: Directly measures zero-shot transfer to an unseen signer with different hand proportions and camera angles without any training exposure to that person.

fold_2_multi_signer_recording_holdout.name: Phase 22/32 Multi-Signer Balanced Recording Holdout
fold_2_multi_signer_recording_holdout.test_partition: signer_04_val (811 frames, 26 recordings, zero recording overlap)
fold_2_multi_signer_recording_holdout.purpose: Measures within-signer condition generalization and recording holdout performance.

current_two_signer_evaluation_protocol.acknowledged_limitation: With only 2 development signers, N=2 is mathematically insufficient to conduct high-variance k-fold cross-validation across diverse physical phenotypes, skin tones, hand sizes, and lighting conditions. Expanding the development pool is an imperative prerequisite for next-generation model training.

demographic_diversity.skin_tones: Fitzpatrick scale representation across Types I-VI

conditions.name: Standard Desktop Frontal
conditions.camera_angle: 0 deg pitch, 0 deg yaw, eye/chest level
conditions.resting_hands: Both hands active or inactive hand completely out of frame

conditions.name: Angled Laptop with Lap Rest
conditions.resting_hands: For 1-handed signs, inactive hand rests visibly in lap/lower torso

quality_control_gates.duplicate_rejection: Deterministic CRC32 and perceptual hash check to reject duplicate takes

candidate_modeling_strategies_audit.name: Multi-Signer Data Expansion with Frozen Feature Schema (280d)
candidate_modeling_strategies_audit.description: Retrain Model C Random Forest using 280d features on the expanded 6-signer cohort (15,000+ diverse frames) without altering the feature schema or pipeline architecture.
candidate_modeling_strategies_audit.rationale: Directly addresses the root cause of cross-signer failure (N=2) without introducing feature dimensionality or compatibility regressions.

candidate_modeling_strategies_audit.name: Variant B 296d Feature Augmentation
candidate_modeling_strategies_audit.description: Include the 16 explicit orientation dimensions (longitudinal and transverse unit vectors, roll angles) validated in Phase 32C alongside the 280d baseline.
candidate_modeling_strategies_audit.rationale: Showed consistent +2.22% zero-shot cross-signer gains and protected Letter R (97%) and H (47%) in Phase 32C.

candidate_modeling_strategies_audit.name: Sliding-Window Temporal Sequence Model (GRU / 1D-CNN)
candidate_modeling_strategies_audit.description: Evaluate temporal aggregation across 5-10 consecutive landmark frames to disambiguate dynamic transitions (e.g., J, Z, motion artifacts).
candidate_modeling_strategies_audit.rationale: Cannot be evaluated on isolated static frames; requires continuous multi-frame video takes from new data collection.

candidate_modeling_strategies_audit.name: Late-Fusion Landmark + Visual Feature Embedding
candidate_modeling_strategies_audit.description: Combine the 280d landmark vector with compact CNN/MobileNet visual embeddings from the hand crop.
candidate_modeling_strategies_audit.rationale: High computational cost, risk of skin-tone overfitting, and exceeds 30ms latency budget on CPU.

gate_1_overall_accuracy.metric: Macro Top-1 Accuracy across held-out development signers (signer_10, signer_11)
gate_1_overall_accuracy.rationale: Represents a decisive jump from the current 40-59% cross-signer baseline.

gate_2_overall_macro_f1.metric: Macro-F1 across all 26 classes on held-out signers
gate_2_overall_macro_f1.rationale: Ensures balanced recognition across both common and rare signs.

gate_3_per_letter_minimum_recall.threshold: >= 50.0% on all 26 classes, >= 75.0% on at least 20 classes

gate_4_orientation_sensitive_safety.metric: Recall on critical orientation signs (H, R, L, Y, P, Q)
gate_4_orientation_sensitive_safety.threshold: No drop greater than 2.0% relative to upright baseline
gate_4_orientation_sensitive_safety.rationale: Guarantees no regression on phonemic orientation.

gate_5_cross_signer_consistency.metric: Accuracy variance across independent held-out signers
gate_5_cross_signer_consistency.rationale: Verifies that the model is truly signer-independent.

gate_6_condition_robustness.rationale: Ensures robustness against elevated camera angles and lap hands.

gate_7_latency_budget.rationale: Strictly guarantees 30 FPS real-time operation on CPU.

gate_8_governance_and_leakage.metric: Sealed holdout quarantine & zero recording leakage
gate_8_governance_and_leakage.threshold: 100% verified (0 shared recordings between train and val; signer_05 completely sealed)
